universal_loop: SIGNAL - name the likely product/role using your knowledge (do not wait for a skill file).
CONFIRM - second observed probe (status/title/headers/banner) on the same asset.
GRADE - observed / inferred / unverified before any severity word.
DEEPEN - on ALL confirmed live crown jewels: crawl, dir probe, JS/API extraction — not titles alone. Historical URLs help but do not replace app depth.
REPORT - finalize gate; never COMPLETE while js_surface_unanalyzed / web_surface_no_app_depth remain on a web-shaped target.

think: Name the product/family from this header using your knowledge (any vendor).
Confirm with a second probe: status + title + 2 more headers on the same host.
Do not claim CRITICAL from a header alone — need auth bypass, data leak, or RCE proof.
Record observed evidence (quote the header) before raising severity.
next_probes: chunked port/service check on resolved IP

think: Treat path as a lead, not exposure. DNS or path ≠ open unauth service.
Probe live: HTTP status, title, auth challenge, redirect chain.
If body is SPA/HTML shell on an API-looking path — demote; prove JSON.
Auth challenge proves a real service surface — note scheme/realm.
Next: is default/weak auth in scope? Only if authorized. Else document as observed auth wall.
next_probes: related sibling hosts on same IP

think: HTML catch-all on /api|/swagger|/graphql is not an open API.
Re-probe for Content-Type: application/json and real JSON body before HIGH/CRITICAL.
SPA shell means real APIs live in JS bundles / XHR — not in the HTML route table.
Fetch index HTML → collect script src → download chunk/main bundles → extract /api paths, keys, internal hosts.
Record findings with tags js_bundle / embedded_api_key / api_endpoint_from_js.
Clear js_surface_unanalyzed before declaring recon done or starting mass vuln scans.
Banner/version is observed footprint — map to weakness classes only after version is solid.
